current_evidence: The council's 'Making an application' page links only this PDF and says 'the revised list was re-adopted on 18 June 2015' and that a review is under way with a draft to be consulted on later; searches found no newer draft or adopted list.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only 12 requirements and missed about 13 of the 25 headings in the list: Affordable housing statement (10+ dwellings where policy requires it); Drainage strategy (housing over 10 units, buildings over 1,000 sq m, sites over 1 ha, or critical drainage problem notified by EA/LLFA); Energy reduction / on-site renewables statement (over 200 dwellings or new buildings over 1,000 sq m); Flood risk assessment (over 1 ha in Flood Zone 1, all in Flood Zones 2/3, critical drainage area); Lighting (floodlighting e.g. car parks, MUGAs); Noise impact assessment (wind turbines, air conditioning, ventilation/extraction, plant/machinery, any noisy use); Parking provision (householder applications affecting parking or adding bedrooms, all full applications, parking layouts); Photographs and photomontages (works to listed buildings, demolition and majors in conservation areas, wind turbines, major commercial/industrial, EIA cases); Planning statement (over 10 dwellings, over 1,000 sq m, or over 1 ha); Statement of Community Involvement (same thresholds); Travel plan (DfT Appendix B thresholds); Retail/leisure impact assessment (over 2,500 sq m gross); Biodiversity survey on designated sites.
issues.evidence: Local List 2015 headings, e.g. Parking provision threshold: 'Any householder application affecting the existing parking arrangements or relating to the provision of additional bedrooms'
issues.grok_comment: Most of the listed headings are indeed missing, but the workbook has 14 distinct requirement rows, not 12. Its "Construction (Environmental) Management Plan" row quotes text from the Drainage strategy entry, so drainage is partly captured, though under the wrong name.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. 14 rows, not 12, and drainage is partly captured under a mislabelled row. The other missing headings stand.

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none) - national requirements only', but the list explicitly applies Parking provision to householder applications. Tree survey (TPO trees or trees in a conservation area) and Noise assessment (air conditioning, plant) can also apply to householder schemes.
issues.evidence: Parking provision threshold: 'Any householder application affecting the existing parking arrangements or relating to the provision of additional bedrooms'

issues.detail: Demolition in a conservation area is marked '(none)', but the Heritage statement and Photographs/photomontages are required for demolition in a conservation area. A Structural survey is required for demolition of a listed building, but Grokbot filed it only under Full planning.
issues.evidence: Heritage statement threshold: 'Demolition within a conservation area or related to a listed building'

issues.detail: Air Quality Assessment is placed under Outline with the note 'Application type named in requirement text'. The only match is the verb in 'outline appropriate mitigation measures'. The real trigger is 200+ dwellings or uses that could contaminate the air, whatever the application type.
issues.evidence: Air quality threshold: 'Applications for 200 or more dwellings' / 'Applications with potentially air contamination uses'

issues.detail: Ten requirements, among them Tree Survey, Contaminated Land, Ecology, EIA, Open space, Retail/sequential test, Structural Survey, Telecommunications, Transport Assessment and Ventilation/Extraction, carry the note 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The list sets triggers by threshold, not application type. Structural survey also covers conversions and listed-building demolition, and Telecommunications covers all telecoms applications, including prior approvals.
issues.evidence: Telecommunications threshold: 'All telecommunications applications'; Structural survey: reuse/conversion outside development limits, agricultural buildings, demolition of a listed building

issues.detail: 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan' is not a heading in the list. The trigger excerpt is a sentence fragment taken from inside the Drainage strategy entry, which asks for a drainage construction management plan.
issues.evidence: Drainage strategy entry: '...a phasing plan and a construction management plan for drainage on site.'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are garbled fragments rather than triggers. Tree Survey begins 'Transport Assessments Tree Survey...'. Contaminated Land is just 'Management of Land Contamination, CLR 11'.'. Open space quotes the land-contamination desktop-study sentence. EIA reads 'This information might form part of an Environmental Statement'. None of these says when the item is needed.
issues.evidence: Real thresholds, e.g. Land contamination: 'Where an application has been submitted which has a vulnerable end user' / 'All major planning applications excluding change of use applications'; Open space: development within designated open spaces

issues.detail: Several triggers leave out the list's actual thresholds. The Heritage Statement excerpt mentions only archaeology and historic landscapes and omits listed building consent, demolition in a conservation area and majors in a conservation area. Transport Assessment/Statement leaves out the DfT Appendix B thresholds. Tree survey leaves out TPO and conservation-area trees and loss of trees. Ventilation leaves out the A3/A4/A5 use trigger.
issues.evidence: Heritage statement threshold: 'Listed building consent' / 'Demolition within a conservation area or related to a listed building' / 'Major applications within a conservation area'

summary: Grokbot's link is to the current list, the 2015 Local List that is still in force while the council reviews it, but the extraction is poor. About half of the 25 requirements are missing, including Parking provision for householders. Several triggers are garbled fragments, one requirement is invented from drainage text, and Air Quality was matched to Outline only because the word 'outline' appears in it.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The reference row says 'Req. items: 14', but tab_items is empty and app_type_rows hold 12 distinct requirements. The List date of 2015-06-01 is an approximation of the stated 18 June 2015.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The list date is an approximation of "Reviewed and re-adopted 18 June 2015", and there are no tab items, as the audit says. But the workbook app-type rows hold 14 distinct requirement names (e.g. Arboricultural, CEMP, Contaminated Land, Heritage, Schedule of works, Air Quality), which matches the stated 14.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The 14 distinct requirement names match the stated count.

grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
